fib: ______ is the ongoing evaluation of learners' performance throughout a health education program, rather than relying solely on final examinations.
Continuous assessment is the ongoing evaluation of learners' performance throughout a health education program, rather than relying solely on final examinations.
______ is a core function of effective health program leadership and management.
Decision-making is a core function of effective health program leadership and management.
______ is the process of determining the effectiveness of teaching methods, learning activities, and health education programmes by analysing assessment results and other relevant information.
Evaluation is the process of determining the effectiveness of teaching methods, learning activities, and health education programmes by analysing assessment results and other relevant information.
______ refer to the obligations of health educators to ensure that their teaching practices, decisions, and actions meet professional standards and effectively support learners' development.

Teacher accountability and responsibility refer to the obligations of health educators to ensure that their teaching practices, decisions, and actions meet professional standards and effectively support learners' development.
______ refers to the active, purposeful communication between teachers and learners during the educational process.
Teaching-learning interaction refers to the active, purposeful communication between teachers and learners during the educational process.
______ is a planned process of helping individuals and communities acquire the knowledge, skills, attitudes, and values needed to make informed decisions about their health.
Health education is a planned process of helping individuals and communities acquire the knowledge, skills, attitudes, and values needed to make informed decisions about their health.
